package.name: mobipick_gripper_effort_controller
package.description: ros_control controller plugin for the simulated Robotiq 2F-140 gripper on Mobipick. It exposes a control_msgs/GripperCommand action (position goal in metres of jaw gap plus max_effort on the Robotiq 30..100 scale) and drives the finger joint through the EffortJointInterface with a PID whose output is clamped to the requested effort, so the torque limit is actually enforced in Gazebo instead of being ignored.
